description_for_human: ENS intelligence for AI agents — natural-language name search, valuation, trading, and identity.
description_for_model: NameWhisper provides 44 MCP tools over ENS names: natural language search across 3.5M indexed ENS names, comparable-sales valuations, and a full trading lifecycle built on Seaport (list, buy, offer, accept, cancel — single, batch, or floor-sweep). Every order is a standard Seaport order on the shared on-chain orderbook, so liquidity is pooled with the wider market including OpenSea. Also: registration, records, swaps, and agent identity (ENSIP-25 / ERC-8004 / ERC-8217).
